sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley on the Moon, Libra and the energy of the Swords (pdf p212).

quotes.quote: The Moon is change, but Nature is peaceful; moreover, Libra represents balance; between them, they regulate the energy of the Swords.
The energy abides above the onslaught of disruption.
